li.label: survivor
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has experienced the danger of a deadly cryptobiological organism. {PAWN_pronoun} is wary of its life cycle and the danger it poses.

li.label: slayer
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} cannot be drawn into cryptimorph obsession or traumatized by their horrors. Encounters with cryptimorphs, or their obsessed hive friends, can provoke a berserker rage. Destroying cryptimorphs brings intense satisfaction.
